text:
Renee: Heads up  were expecting a high nomination volume at tomorrows Hiring Fair booth. need surge plan for spot awards and cross-team approvals.
Omar: I can be on-site from 10:3012:30. suggestion: pre-print 200 nomination cards and 50 approval stickers.
Jules: I'll bring a tablet with the offline CSV form for batch entry. wifi in the hall drops sometimes.
Kay: Finance notes: keep float to $200, receipts mandatory, and tag country for any remote awards. finance-bot will auto-flag >$100.
Maya: For fairness, let's cap walk-up awards at $75 unless manager pre-approves. have a small envelope stack for sealed awards.
Renee: Agreed. Action items:
- Jules: offline CSV + tablet preloaded (due tonight)
- Omar: bring 200 cards + labeler + approval sticker print (today PM)
- Kay: petty cash form submitted and float approved $200
- Maya: signage for "Nominate a Teammate" + "Quiet Nomination" (A3)
peopleops-bot: Checklist saved to /docs/events/hiring-fair/spot-awards-surge-plan.pdf
Omar: Quick ops Q: how to handle foreign recipients who need local vouchers? procurement lead-time is 3 days.
Kay: If recipient is outside NA, issue an e-gift USD code and follow up with local voucher after event if requested. tag country in CSV.
Jules: I'll add a required "country" column and "manager name" field to the offline form so finance-bot can tag entries.
Maya: Volunteers: 10:0011:00 Renee + Omar; 11:0012:30 Jules + Maya; float/follow-up 12:301:30 Kay + floater.
Renee: Also include a simple manager pre-approval envelope box for managers to drop signed approvals before the event.
Omar: I'll bring a locking box for pre-approvals and a small laminator to protect stickers from rain.
Kay: Reminder: please take photos of receipts with phone and upload within 48 hours. finance-bot will remind if missing.
Renee: Thanks team. locking plan unless anyone raises a blocker by 7pm.
Maya: All clear. will post a volunteer ping in #all-hands. :tada:
